title: Marathon Framework variables
description: Configuration variables for the Marathon application orchestration framework on Apache Mesos

MARATHON_VERSION.description: Specific version of Marathon to install.

MARATHON_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install Marathon ('libscript_native' isolates binaries in LIBSCRIPT_HOME, 'system' uses OS packages).

MARATHON_HTTP_PORT.description: TCP port on which the Marathon v2 REST API and UI listen.

MARATHON_MASTER.description: Apache Mesos master connection URL or ZooKeeper master path (e.g. 'zk://127.0.0.1:2181/mesos' or '127.0.0.1:5050').

MARATHON_ZK.description: ZooKeeper connection URI for Marathon framework state persistence and HA leader election.

MARATHON_HOSTNAME.description: Advertised hostname or IP address for the Marathon scheduler node.

MARATHON_HOME.description: Filesystem directory or path configuration for marathon (MARATHON_HOME).

MARATHON_STATE_DIR.description: Filesystem directory or path configuration for marathon (MARATHON_STATE_DIR).
